{{Quote|Hangar 8122. Broadside, Matchstick, you know the drill.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Procedure">''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], '''Hangar 8122''' was located on the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]-affiliated [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|testing facility]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]]&mdash;a [[blue]], luminescent [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Procedure" /> in the [[Bormus system/Legends|Bormus system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], arrived with [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] to acquire [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]&mdash;which were stored in [[Hangar/Legends|Hangar]] 8122&mdash;for his [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|assault]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. Shadow Squadron's [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilots]] were initially denied access to 8122 by the facility's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], but they were allowed to enter the hangar when they mentioned the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] accompanying them to the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] standing guard.<ref name="Procedure" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hangar 8122 appeared in the six-page [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], illustrated and lettered by [[Grant Gould]], and based on an idea by [[Henry Gilroy]].<ref name="Procedure" /> The comic was posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[October 6]], [[2008]],<ref name="The Clone Wars archives-tenth page">{{SWArchive|url=archives/index.html?c=d6de5d83-4da5-48ab-bf34-75cd3af8fbef&k=&page=10|text=''The Clone Wars'' archives-tenth page}}</ref> and is part of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic series]], which ties into the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series of the same name]].<ref name="Procedure" /> ''Procedure'' leads directly into "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of ''The Clone Wars'' television series.<ref name="The Clone Wars Episode Guide: Shadow of Malevolence">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
